android.releaseNotes:
• Fixed WebRTC calling regressions (answer button, screen flicker).
• Improved audio routing for Bluetooth headsets and peripherals.
• Resolved potential Stack Overflow and initialization errors during calls.
• Fixed chat background images not loading by using public R2 URLs.
